column1: # German grammar words. One line per word as written + part of speech:
# word <TAB> UD part of speech <TAB> senses separated by " | ".
# The file replaces Wiktionary's determiner, pronoun, preposition, conjunction,
# particle and auxiliary entries for every word listed here; nouns, verbs and
# other content words stay. Case matters (Sie / sie).
# Irregular verb forms a reader can't connect to their infinitive get lines of
# their own (`gab` "gave", `ging` "went"): the protocol has no inflection
# tables. "→ geben" links the line to its verb, which the popover still shows
# after it; a VERB line replaces Wiktionary's other verbs for the word.
